WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-85.442614 43.468138, -85.442675 43.381294, -85.50231 43.38105, -85.562586 43.381185, -85.562406 43.468089, -85.522149 43.46773, -85.48225 43.467983, -85.482035 43.467984, -85.442614 43.468138))', 4326) AS g
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g)
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(rast))).min AS elevation
FROM clipped;
